title: Nice lettering but the string ruins the look
text:
Nice lettering but the string ruins the look. I really like the lettering on this set (see photo). However, the string provided ruins the look. There are holes in the tops of the letters that need to be punched out and through which this string is passed. The letter H, T, Y, etc. have two holes, etc. However, I feel it would have been best if a gold string-like ribbon were provided instead of this thread as it cheapens the look.

The current price of $7.19 ($7.99 minus 10%) is a bit pricey, especially since only the letters are wonderful.
